text: For the incident write-up: at what time did Gideon call both Hartford gate lanes working again on 3 Aug, and which trailer was the first check-in once kiosk 1 came back?
reply_text:

- **First check-in after kiosk 1 came back:** Mateo reported at 11:03 AM that kiosk 1 was back and that the guard checked in **trailer 8836**, which dispatch could see. That is the only check-in mentioned after kiosk 1 returned, so it is the first one in the channel.
